We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products. Customer calls and the weekly support rotation are part of the job, not a distraction from it.   Find the right problems to solve   In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will focus on real developer pain: flaky tests and flaky checks, unclear failures, noisy alerts. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.   Own your work end to end   From shaping the initial idea, through implementation and rollout, to watching how it behaves in production. You will take part in on-call and help support customers when things don’t work as expected.    What you should have     You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them.
